problem_statement: When the multicast DNS responder receives two queries in close succession (e.g. two PTR queries for two distinct service types arriving a few milliseconds apart), it must combine the answers for both queries into a single multicast response message that contains both services' PTR records in the answer section and their SRV/TXT records in the additional section. On the unfixed code, each query is answered with its own independently scheduled response, so two separate multicast response messages are produced instead of one aggregated message. Registering a TCP service and a UDP service and then issuing the two PTR queries for their service types should yield exactly one response message with two answers and four additional records.
